privacy_notice_body.message: EasyCV reads the current page address to match your site rules and processes the page in your browser to remove copy, paste, selection and right-click restrictions. Your rules and settings may sync through your browser. Activation counts and a backup of older site data stay on this device. Nothing is sent to the developer.
